system.description: Demesure is a sinful pride that exacts extraordinary, sometimes horrendous costs from its possessor and those around him. Choose (with the Storyteller) one or more things your character takes great pride in. When that pride is insulted or threatened, roll Willpower (difficulty 9); failure means the character pursues the salvation of his "honor" to the exclusion of all other business, potentially losing allies, ruining plans, or courting Final Death. Achieving a goal related to the obsession allows a Willpower roll (difficulty 7) to let it rest for the remainder of the night.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book One: Artisans
